_doc: Single source of truth for look & feel. build_prompt.py composes every generation prompt from this file + the camera's visible elements. Change taste here, never in ad-hoc prompts. Proven recipe (bake-off 2026-10-11, LIV_B): 'retexture pass' prompt on the line-burned blockout scored 0.81 structural (= perfect self-match 0.81); design-brief prompts scored 0.06-0.42 because the model redesigns the room.

global.positioning: ultra-luxury contemporary residence; warm, wood-rich, lived-in, quietly expensive (no gold bling, no clutter)
global.photography: high-end architectural interior photography, full-frame camera, 24mm tilt-shift lens, perfectly vertical verticals, eye-level two-point perspective, natural exposure balanced for interior and window, subtle depth, crisp detail, no lens distortion
global.render_quality: photorealistic, indistinguishable from a photograph, physically correct global illumination, soft contact shadows, real material micro-detail (wood grain, stone veining, leather creases, fabric weave), Corona/V-Ray archviz quality
global.never: no people, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no extra windows or doors, no moved or resized walls, no missing furniture, no extra seating, no fisheye, no tilted verticals, no CGI plastic look, no oversaturation, no clutter
global.life_details_allowed: decor may be ADDED only on existing surfaces or hung from ceiling/walls: books, ceramics, sculptural vases, fresh flowers/branches, olive trees or large potted plants in free floor corners, throws and cushions, framed art, rugs under existing furniture, candles, a bowl of fruit, folded towels, a coffee cup. Decor must never cover a window, door or required furniture piece.
global.time_of_day: one moment for the whole house: golden hour, about 18:00 in late spring - low warm sun from the south-west entering ONLY through the south and east glass, long soft sun patches on the floor; interior lights on at 70%
global.exterior: outside every window the SAME view: a landscaped garden with lawn, a clipped hedge and a few olive trees, soft green hills far behind, clear sky with a few soft clouds. Never sea, never city.
global.time_of_day_upper: the SAME moment as the whole house: golden hour, about 18:00 in late spring - low warm sun streams in through the glass, long soft honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls, warm glowing air; the interior LED lines, coves, seams and lamps are on at 50% so they still glow softly; bright, warm, inviting - never night, never dark
global.exterior_upper: this is the FIRST FLOOR, about 4.5 m above the garden: through the glass the view looks slightly DOWN onto the sunlit lawn, the clipped hedge and the rounded crowns of the olive trees below, soft green hills on the horizon at eye level under a clear warm golden sky with a few soft clouds. Never sea, never city, never a view at ground level, never night.

lighting_rules: Daylight enters ONLY through openings that exist in the blockout; light direction and sun patches must be consistent with where those openings are.
Late-afternoon warm daylight (approx 4500K) through glazing + warm 2700K interior accents.
Accent lighting: recessed linear LED in ceiling slats, LED strips under counters/shelves, backlit niches, magnetic track spots; all fixtures warm white.
Dark rooms (spa, WC, sauna) are lit low and moody: grazing light on stone, pools of amber light, high contrast.
Never brighten a dark-style room to look like a showroom; never darken the living room - it is light-filled.

V_R_hall.concept: First-floor landing + gallery office overlooking the double-height living through a frameless glass balustrade: smoked-oak herringbone floor, warm greige plaster, a sculptural walnut desk with a cognac leather desk chair, two curved ivory boucle lounge chairs, a dark wool rug, an alabaster pendant, the monumental abstract painting on the back wall, a fiddle-leaf fig.

retexture.light: golden hour: low warm sun streams in through the glass, long honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls, the crystal chandelier glowing in the void

V_R_master.concept: Master bedroom, dark with bright details: dark walnut floor, deep espresso plaster, the bed wall in espresso walnut boiserie with thin brass inlays, a tall cognac leather channel headboard, a cream textured artwork above it, opal globe pendants on brass rods, cream travertine nightstands, ivory linen bedding, an ivory rug, espresso walnut + bronze-glass walk-in wardrobes lit inside, an olive tree, sheer curtains at the sliding glass.

retexture.light: golden hour: low warm sun streams in through the glass, long honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls; the room stays dark and moody, the globes glow softly

V_R_mbath.concept: Master ensuite, 70 % dark: honed charcoal limestone walls, dark stone floor, a white Calacatta Gold shower wall (bright detail), a smoked-walnut double vanity with a cream travertine top, two backlit mirrors, clear glass shower, black fittings, ceiling cove.

retexture.light: moody and warm: soft glow from the cove, the backlit mirrors and under the vanity

V_R_bed1.concept: Bedroom 1: smoked-oak herringbone floor, deep olive-brown plaster, the bed wall in vertical walnut slats with a warm wash light, a tall olive velvet channel headboard, cream travertine nightstands, opal globe pendants, ivory bedding, an ivory rug, a fluted smoked-oak wardrobe, a walnut TV wall, a fiddle-leaf fig, full-height french window with sheer curtains.

retexture.light: golden hour: low warm sun streams in through the glass, long honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls; dark and cosy with bright cream details

V_R_bed2.concept: Bedroom 2: dark walnut floor, warm charcoal plaster, the bed wall in ribbed smoked oak, a tall sand-linen channel headboard, ivory bedding with a rust linen throw, cream travertine nightstands, alabaster pendants, an ivory rug, a reeded walnut wardrobe, a ribbed-oak TV wall, a fiddle-leaf fig, full-height window with sheer curtains.

retexture.light: golden hour: low warm sun streams in through the glass, long honey-coloured sun patches on the floor and walls; dark and cosy with bright sand and rust details

V_R_bath1.concept: Bath 1, 70 % dark: deep green-black Verde Guatemala marble walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; bright details: a floating cream travertine vanity slab, brushed-brass fittings and rain head, a backlit mirror, a lit niche, clear glass shower; small high window.

retexture.light: moody and warm: soft glow from the cove, the mirror and under the vanity, a little golden evening light from the window

V_R_bath2.concept: Bath 2, 70 % dark: dark chocolate Emperador marble walls, dark stone floor, dark ceiling; bright details: a white Calacatta Gold shower wall, a smoked-walnut vanity with a white top, a backlit mirror, clear glass shower, black fittings; small high window.

retexture.light: moody and warm: soft glow from the cove, the mirror and under the vanity, a little golden evening light from the window
